description: This file defines the FloatDatatype class, a custom datatype for representing floating point numbers as part of the OpenMRS system. It extends SerializingCustomDatatype and provides methods to serialize and deserialize Float objects.

classes.name: FloatDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype class for handling Float values within OpenMRS, supporting serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a Float object into its String representation. Returns null if the input is null.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a String into a Float object. Returns null if the string is empty or null.
